A collection of interesting links featuring open-access books, tutorials, and articles on data analysis, data visualization, and reproducible workflow.


<hr>


#### R+
* [Big Book of R](https://www.bigbookofr.com/){target=_blank} by _Oscar Baruffa_.  
* [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/index.html){target=_blank} by _Hadley Wickham_ and _Garrett Grolemund_.  
* [R Packages](https://r-pkgs.org){target=_blank} by _Hadley Wickham_ and _Jenny Bryan_.  

#### Git and GitHub
* [Happy Git with R](https://happygitwithr.com){target=_blank} by _Jenny Bryan_.  
* [Notes on Git and GitHub](https://daczarne.github.io/notes_on_git_and_github/index.html){target=_blank} by _Daniel Czarnievicz_.  

#### Bayesian data analysis
* [Doing Bayesian Data Analysis](https://sites.google.com/site/doingbayesiandataanalysis/){target=_blank} by _John Kruschke_.  
	+ [(Re)Doing Bayesain Data Analysis](https://rpruim.github.io/Kruschke-Notes/){target=_blank} by _R Pruim_.  
	+ [Doing Bayesian Data Analysis in brms and the tidyverse](https://solomon.quarto.pub/dbda2/){target=_blank} by _A Solomon Kurz_.  
* [Statistical Rethinking](http://xcelab.net/rm/statistical-rethinking/){target=_blank} by _Richard McElreath_.  
	+ [Statistical rethinking with brms, ggplot2, and the tidyverse](https://solomon.quarto.pub/sr/){target=_blank} by _A Solomon Kurz_.  
	
#### Data visualization
* [Fundamentals of Data Visualization](https://clauswilke.com/dataviz/){target=_blank} by _Claus O. Wilke_.  
* [Data Visualization](https://socviz.co/){target=_blank} by _Kieran Healy_.  

#### Reproducible reports
* [Reproducible Research Tutorial Series](https://riffomonas.org/reproducible_research/){target=_blank} 
and [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/c/RiffomonasProject){target=_blank} by _Riffomonas_.  
* [initial steps toward reproducible research](https://kbroman.org/steps2rr/){target=_blank} by _Karl Broman_.
